image:image.image:title: Base Granules — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: High-hardness mineral carrier granules engineered from natural Gypsum, Dolomite, and Calcite to provide a dust-free, high crush-strength substrate for bio-fertilizer coating and secondary Ca, Mg, and S soil conditioning.

image:image.image:title: Coated Base Granules (BIO NPK) — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: High-hardness mineral carrier granules coated with a bio-active microbial consortium (Azotobacter, PSB, KMB) that fixes atmospheric nitrogen, solubilizes locked phosphates, and mobilizes potassium while supplying core calcium and sulfur.

image:image.image:title: Coated Base Granules (Mycorrhiza) — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: High-integrity mineral carrier granules coated with concentrated endo-mycorrhizal spores using a bio-compatible organic sticker that preserves spore viability and establishes expansive symbiotic hyphal networks in the root zone.

image:image.image:title: Customized Base Granules — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: Custom-formulated mineral carrier granules tailored to precise bulk density, particle sizing (2–4 mm), pH buffering range, and secondary mineral stoichiometry (Gypsum, Dolomite, Silica, Organic Carbon) for B2B fertilizer manufacturers and blenders.

image:image.image:title: Customized Coated Granules — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: Industrial custom coating and private-label manufacturing service applying proprietary Bio NPK, Mycorrhizal endo-spores, humic/fulvic acids, seaweed extracts, or chelated micronutrients onto high-hardness mineral carrier bases with low-temperature drying.

image:image.image:title: Diatomite Silicon — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: FCO-certified natural amorphous biogenic silica granules (SiO2·nH2O) with ultra-high microporosity that release plant-available orthosilicic acid (H4SiO4) to strengthen leaf cuticles, reduce lodging, and maximize soil moisture retention.

image:image.image:title: Enriched Base Granules — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: High-grade mineral carrier granules fortified with secondary nutrients (Calcium, Magnesium, Sulfate-Sulfur) and essential trace elements built directly into the core matrix for sustained multi-mineral rhizosphere feeding.

image:image.image:title: Humic Based Granules — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: High-potency organic soil conditioner granules engineered with concentrated Potassium Humate and Fulvate fractions to boost soil Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC), chelate micronutrients, and stimulate lateral root initiation.

image:image.image:title: Mycorrhiza Granules (Biofertilizers) — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: FCO-certified Vesicular Arbuscular Mycorrhizal (VAM) biofertilizer granules formulated with high-viability endo-mycorrhizal spores (min. 100 IP/gm) on a protective mineral carrier to expand active root absorptive volume by up to 700%.

image:image.image:title: Organic Carbon Base Granules — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: Engineered high-carbon mineral carrier granules (min. 18.0% bio-active organic carbon) designed to replenish depleted soil organic matter (SOM), feed beneficial rhizosphere microflora, and maximize water infiltration.

image:image.image:title: Organic Manure — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: FCO-certified thermophilically stabilized organic manure (min. 16.0% organic carbon, C:N ratio < 20:1) enriched with humic fractions and beneficial soil microflora to restore soil organic matter (SOM), cation exchange capacity (CEC), and moisture holding capacity.

image:image.image:title: Other Nutrients Base Granules — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: Precision-engineered mineral carrier granules formulated with essential micronutrient packages—including Zinc (Zn), Boron (B), Iron (Fe), Manganese (Mn), and Sulfur (S)—integrated directly into the granule core to prevent physical segregation in dry bulk fertilizer blends.

image:image.image:title: Pancharatna Base Granules — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: Engineered 5-in-1 multi-mineral base granules co-granulating Calcium (Ca), Magnesium (Mg), Sulfur (S), Silicon (Si), and Organic Carbon into a single high-hardness particle to correct multi-nutrient soil deficiencies and buffer rhizosphere pH.

image:image.image:title: Potash Derived from Molasses (PDM) — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: FCO-certified organic bio-potassium fertilizer (min. 14.5% water-soluble K2O, min. 16.0% organic carbon) enriched with organic sulfur, calcium, and fulvic fractions to optimize fruit brix, grain density, and drought resilience without chloride toxicity.

image:image.image:title: Plant Available Silica — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: High-bioavailability silica base granules engineered to release soluble monosilicic acid (H4SiO4) that reinforces cell walls, prevents cereal lodging, and boosts abiotic stress tolerance.

image:image.image:title: Phosphate Rich Organic Manure (PROM) — J K Fertilizers
image:image.image:caption: FCO-certified organic phosphatic bio-fertilizer (min. 10.4% total P2O5, min. 7.9% organic carbon) formulated with fine rock phosphate, composted organic matter, and phosphate-solubilizing bio-agents to replace synthetic DAP and SSP.
